title.en: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and consumer rights
title.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2019 ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು

hook.en: Every time you buy a phone, a bus ticket or a plate of idli, the law gives you six rights. Most people do not know them.

objectives.en: State who is a consumer under the Act
Explain the six rights of consumers

narration.en: Every time you buy a phone, a bus ticket or a plate of idli, the law gives you six rights. Most people do not know them.

body.en: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, a consumer is a person who buys goods or hires or avails services for a consideration (paid, promised or partly paid), including the user of such goods or beneficiary of such services with the buyer's approval. It includes offline and online transactions. A person who buys goods for resale or for a commercial purpose is not a consumer.
body.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2019ರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಕು ಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಅಥವಾ ಸೇವೆ ಪಡೆಯುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕ. ಮರುಮಾರಾಟ ಅಥವಾ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಳ್ಳುವವನು ಗ್ರಾಹಕನಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Includes the user with the buyer's approval
Excludes purchase for resale or commercial purpose

title.en: On the board: Who is a consumer; six rights

narration.en: Under the 2019 Act a consumer buys goods or hires services for a price, online or offline.

say.en: Under the 2019 Act a consumer buys goods or hires services for a price, online or offline.
A person who buys for resale or commercial purpose is not a consumer.
The Act gives six rights. The first three: safety, information and choice.
Then: to be heard, to seek redressal, and to consumer education.

body.en: The six rights: Right to Safety (protection against hazardous goods, e.g. buy ISI-marked appliances); Right to be Informed (about quality, quantity, price, ingredients, date of manufacture); Right to Choose (from a variety of products at competitive prices); Right to be Heard (to file a complaint and have it considered); Right to seek Redressal (to get relief such as replacement, refund or compensation); Right to Consumer Education (to be aware of rights and reliefs).
body.kn: ಆರು ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು: ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಯ ಹಕ್ಕು, ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಹಕ್ಕು, ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ಹಕ್ಕು, ಅಹವಾಲು ಕೇಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಹಕ್ಕು, ಪರಿಹಾರ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಹಕ್ಕು ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಹಕ್ಕು.

problem.en: A shopkeeper insists that a customer buying a gas stove must buy his brand of lighter too, and refuses to show other brands. Which right is violated?

steps.en: The customer is being forced to buy a particular product.
He is denied the opportunity to choose among brands at competitive prices.
This violates the right to choose.
